summary: First two attempts at the fit.reference_rank benchmark produced no usable measurement. Both arms failed for reasons in our own code, not in the models. Preserved here because the rows were deleted from D1 so a clean re-run could not mistake them for completed work.
why_void: Anthropic arm (Opus 5): every call returned HTTP 400. The request carried thinking.type=enabled with budget_tokens, which current models reject; they require thinking.type=adaptive with output_config.effort. Zero tokens billed.

OpenAI arm (gpt-5.6-sol): calls succeeded but returned an empty result set, because compilePrompt String-coerces variables and the postings variable was stored as a JSON array, so the model received a prompt reading '[object Object]' where the postings should have been. The empty answer was correct for the prompt actually sent. $0.0676 billed for nothing.
fixes_landed: eval_cases.variables_json postings now stored as TEXT
